name: Albatera (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, red and yellow with a red middle stripe of double width, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Albatera (a chalice, a horn and a scallop).
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 3 September 1999 of the Conseller de Justícia i Administracions Públiques, published in the DOGV no. 3.614 of 28 October 1999, as a flag of proportions 2:3 divided vertically in three with the central red stripe of double width charged with the municipal arms, blue at the hoist and yellow at the fly.

features.role: Albatera arms — chalice, horn and scallop
